text: You cannot change your future, but you can change your habits, and surely your habits will change your future.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Dream is not that which you see while sleeping, it is something that does not let you sleep.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: All birds find shelter during a rain. But Eagle avoids rain by flying above the Clouds. Problems are common, but attitude makes the difference.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Confidence and hard-work is the best medicine to kill the disease called failure. It will make you a successful person.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Failure will never overtake me if my determination to succeed is strong enough.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Don't take rest after your first victory because if you fail in second, more lips are waiting to say that your first victory was just luck.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: To succeed in your mission, you must have single-minded devotion to your goal.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Let us sacrifice our today so that our children can have a better tomorrow.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Small aim is a crime; have great aim.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Difficulty in life does not come to destroy you, but to help you realize your hidden potential and power.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text: Learning gives creativity, creativity leads to thinking, thinking provides knowledge, knowledge makes you great.
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

text:
बाधाएं आती हैं आएं, घिरें प्रलय की घोर घटाएं,
पावों के नीचे अंगारे, सिर पर बरसें यदि ज्वालाएं,
निज हाथों में हंसते-हंसते, आग लगाकर जलना होगा,
क़दम मिलाकर चलना होगा।
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text:
गीत नया गाता हूँ,
टूटे हुए तारों से फूटे बासंती स्वर,
पत्थर की छाती में उग आया नव अंकुर,
झरे सब पीले पात, कोयल की कुहुक रात,
प्राची में अरुणिम की रेख देख पाता हूँ,
गीत नया गाता हूँ।
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text:
हार नहीं मानूंगा, रार नहीं ठानूंगा,
काल के कपाल पर लिखता मिटाता हूं,
गीत नया गाता हूं।
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text:
मौत से ठन गई!
जूझने का मेरा इरादा न था,
मोड़ पर मिलेंगे इसका वादा न था,
रास्ता रोक कर वह खड़ी हो गई,
यों लगा ज़िन्दगी से बड़ी हो गई।
पर मैं मौत से नहीं डरता, मौत से ठन गई!
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text: भारत ज़मीन का टुकड़ा नहीं, जीता-जागता राष्ट्रपुरुष है। यह वंदन की भूमि है, यह अभिनंदन की भूमि है। इसका कंकर-कंकर शंकर है, इसका बिंदु-बिंदु गंगाजल है। हम जिएंगे तो इसके लिए, मरेंगे तो इसके लिए।
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Statesman

text: You can change friends but not neighbors.
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Statesman

text: Our nuclear weapons are strictly for deterrence against force, not for aggression.
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Statesman

text: Victory and defeat are part of life, which are to be viewed with equanimity.
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Statesman

text: छोटे मन से कोई बड़ा नहीं होता, टूटे मन से कोई खड़ा नहीं होता।
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text: My poetry is a declaration of war, not an exordium to defeat. It is not the defeated soldier's drumbeat of despair, but the fighting warrior's will to win.
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
authorRole: Former Prime Minister of India & Legendary Poet

text: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life; dream of it; think of it; live on that idea. Let the brain, the body, muscles, nerves, every part of your body be full of that idea. This is the way to success.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: You have to grow from the inside out. None can teach you, none can make you spiritual. There is no other teacher but your own soul.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: In a day, when you don't come across any problems - you can be sure that you are travelling in a wrong path.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Strength is Life, Weakness is Death. Expansion is Life, Contraction is Death. Love is Life, Hatred is Death.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: All the powers in the universe are already ours. It is we who have put our hands before our eyes and cry that it is dark.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Talk to yourself once in a day, otherwise you may miss meeting an intelligent person in this world.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
author: Steve Jobs

text: The people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world are the ones who do.
author: Steve Jobs

text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Imagination is more important than knowledge. For knowledge is limited, whereas imagination embraces the entire world.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow. The important thing is not to stop questioning.
author: Albert Einstein

text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value.
author: Albert Einstein

text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
author: Nelson Mandela
authorRole: Former President of South Africa & Freedom Fighter

text: I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it. The brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.
author: Nelson Mandela
authorRole: Former President of South Africa & Freedom Fighter

text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
author: Nelson Mandela
authorRole: Former President of South Africa & Freedom Fighter

text: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
author: Nelson Mandela
authorRole: Former President of South Africa & Freedom Fighter

author: Rabindranath Tagore

text: You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

text: Faith is the bird that feels the light when the dawn is still dark.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

text: They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas. They can crush my body, but they will not be able to crush my spirit.
author: Bhagat Singh

text: Zindagi to apne dam par hi jiyi jaati hai, dusron ke kandhon par to sirf janaaze uthaye jaate hain.
author: Bhagat Singh

text: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can't live long enough to make them all yourselves.
author: Chanakya

text: A person should not be too honest. Straight trees are cut first and honest people are screwed first.
author: Chanakya

text: Before you start some work, always ask yourself three questions: Why am I doing it, What the results might be, and Will I be successful. Only when you think deeply and find satisfactory answers, go ahead.
author: Chanakya

text: Cultivation of mind should be the ultimate aim of human existence.
author: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
authorRole: Father of the Indian Constitution & Visionary

text: Educate, Agitate, Organize. Have faith in yourselves.
author: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
authorRole: Father of the Indian Constitution & Visionary

text: Life should be great rather than long.
author: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
authorRole: Father of the Indian Constitution & Visionary

text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
authorRole: Civil Rights Leader & Nobel Peace Laureate

text: If you can't fly then run, if you can't run then walk, if you can't walk then crawl, but whatever you do you have to keep moving forward.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
authorRole: Civil Rights Leader & Nobel Peace Laureate

text: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
